column1: ## Mercury FINALIZER pipeline (FNLZR) -- ordered stages that turn a Mercury/capmerc ELF into native SASS.
## "stage_name" = descriptive label / phase tag recovered from binary strings where present.
## "bin_fn" = binary-confirmed ptxas function VMA where known; "-" = stage is internal/inlined or arch-ucode (not separately documented here).
## The lib driver gates and parses input (stages 1-3); per-text-section codegen runs the SASS machine (GenerateSASS sub-phases); stages 5-12 remap relocs, size, and emit the SASS ELF.

column5: gate input: 64-bit, EF_IS_MERCURY set, e_type in {ET_REL,ET_EXEC,ET_EWP}, abiVersion==ELFMERCABIV_ABI(0); arch-compatible / off-target family check (sub_60F290)
group each Mercury .text.<fn> with its SHT_RELA reloc sec + SHT_CUDA_INFO nvinfo sec; build SASS symbol table, section-group info
parse reloc + text nvinfo sections -> per-section meta-info; parse global nvinfo section
run the SASS machine per text section (see SASS_* sub-stages); min-heap threadpool bins sections by summed size across the available core count
decode Mercury packet stream (MPE) into Mercury IR
expand pseudo/macro Mercury ops into concrete instruction forms
emit final SASS bytes; build instr-offset vector (Mercury offset -> SASS offset), record yield instr offsets / count
remap reloc offsets byte->instr via instr-offset vector[off/bytes_in_mpe]; PROG_REL32/_HI/_LO -> R_CUDA_NONE (set during emit); clear const-bank relocs; add yield relocation if vSM<70
FNLZR-vs-driver split: handler==NVRH_FINALIZER -> defer to the deferred-reloc list (no output rela slot); else emit rela with the merc->sass reloc conversion(rtype)
size the output SASS ELF; only EIATTR_FRAME_SIZE / EIATTR_MIN_STACK_SIZE in global nvinfo may grow
write SASS ELF; clear EF_CUDA_MERCURY; abiVersion=ELFOSABIV_LATEST(7); set EF_CUDA_64BIT_ADDRESS; demote shared/global/local to NOBITS for ET_EXEC; phoff=phnum=0
emit .nv.merc.* clones (SHT_CUDA_MERCURY), Mercury-to-SASS map sections (SHT_CUDA_MERCURY_SASS_MAP), renamed Mercury constant banks
AFTER text-section symbol values are set: patch deferred FNLZR relocs in place; NVRS_ADDR (32/64) + NVRS_ADDR8_* lanes only, else ELFNLZR_ERROR_INVALID_RELOCATION

column5: content-equality dedup of constant blobs (stage1 of sub_1CB8E40) then symbol/name dedup (sub_1CB68D0); see dedup_functions.tsv
